<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#EFF2F6"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="16" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">9:41</text>

  <line x1="351" y1="13" x2="354" y2="16" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="362" y="6" width="21" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="364" y="8" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#111111"/>
  <rect x="384" y="9" width="2" height="5" fill="#111111"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="24" width="390" height="60" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="30,54 23,60 30,66" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="60" x2="39" y2="60" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="55" y="66" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Filters</text>
  <text x="334" y="63" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">Clear all</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="83.5" x2="390" y2="83.5" stroke="#5F5F5F" stroke-opacity="0.5" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- content heading -->
  <text x="20" y="116" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Filter by member profile</text>
  <text x="20" y="138" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">Narrow your search with the details below.</text>

  <!-- age card -->
  <rect x="19" y="154" width="352" height="116" rx="4" fill="#111111" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="18" y="152" width="352" height="116" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="32" y="177" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Age range</text>
  <text x="32" y="194" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">Choose the preferred age range</text>
  <text x="32" y="211" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">Minimum age</text>
  <rect x="31" y="217" width="143" height="40" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <text x="45" y="242" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">25</text>
  <polygon points="157,233 163,233 160,237" fill="#111111"/>
  <text x="196" y="211" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">Maximum age</text>
  <rect x="195" y="217" width="143" height="40" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <text x="209" y="242" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">34</text>
  <polygon points="321,233 327,233 324,237" fill="#111111"/>

  <!-- member ID -->
  <rect x="19" y="284" width="352" height="91" rx="4" fill="#111111" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="18" y="282" width="352" height="91" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="32" y="307" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Member ID</text>
  <text x="32" y="324" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">Search for a specific member</text>
  <rect x="31" y="332" width="307" height="28" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <text x="43" y="350" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">MM-20481</text>

  <!-- height -->
  <rect x="19" y="389" width="352" height="116" rx="4" fill="#111111" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="18" y="387" width="352" height="116" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="32" y="412" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Height</text>
  <text x="32" y="429" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">Set a preferred height range</text>
  <text x="32" y="446" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">From</text>
  <rect x="31" y="452" width="143" height="40" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <text x="44" y="477" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">5'4"</text>
  <polygon points="157,468 163,468 160,472" fill="#111111"/>
  <text x="195" y="446" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">To</text>
  <rect x="195" y="452" width="143" height="40" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <text x="208" y="477" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">6'2"</text>
  <polygon points="321,468 327,468 324,472" fill="#111111"/>

  <!-- demographic section -->
  <rect x="18" y="519" width="352" height="119" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="32" y="546" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Demographics</text>
  <text x="32" y="569" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#5F5F5F">Gender</text>
  <rect x="31" y="578" width="74" height="32" rx="16" fill="#111111"/>
  <text x="49" y="599" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Any</text>
  <rect x="113" y="578" width="89" height="32" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1"/>

  <rect x="210" y="578" width="89" height="32" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="230" y="599" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">Men</text>

  <!-- profile criteria -->
  <rect x="19" y="654" width="352" height="91" rx="4" fill="#111111" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="18" y="652" width="352" height="91" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="32" y="678" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Profile criteria</text>
  <rect x="32" y="693" width="18" height="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="35,701 40,706 48,697" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="61" y="707" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">Has a profile photo</text>
  <rect x="197" y="693" width="18" height="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="200,701 205,706 213,697" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="226" y="707" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">Verified member</text>
  <line x1="18" y1="757" x2="370" y2="757" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- action buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="766" width="214" height="42" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="125" y="792" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Apply filters</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="242" y="766" width="128" height="42" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="306" y="792" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">Reset</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="818" width="390" height="26" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="818" x2="390" y2="818" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="38,829 45,823 52,829 52,836 43,836 43,831 41,831 41,836 32,836 32,829" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="42" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Home</text>
  <circle cx="121" cy="828" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="125" y1="832" x2="130" y2="837" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="121" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#979797">Browse</text>
  <polygon points="197,823 199,827 204,827 200,830 202,835 197,832 193,835 194,830 190,827 195,827" fill="#111111"/>

  <rect x="268" y="824" width="14" height="10" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="271,834 270,838 275,834" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="279" cy="826" r="2" fill="#111111"/>
  <text x="275" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#979797">Messages</text>
  <circle cx="352" cy="826" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="352" cy="836" rx="8" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="352" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#979797">Account</text>
</svg>
